author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Chat with your ebooks on static HTML page.   No server, no API call, you can even host it on github.io pages.

I implemented a good old RAG system using Gemma4 running in your browser.

https://lnkd.in/dsGRMjKw

shared_article.title: GitHub - hevangel/offline-rag-library: Agent Skill that scaffolds offline single-page library sites with in-browser RAG chatbots — EPUB→markdown conversion, prebuilt embeddings, and zero-server, zero-API-key retrieval via transformers.js + WebGPU.
